extracted.intended_audience: practising journalists and students of journalism
extracted.subtask_description: A practical guide to producing clear, engaging journalistic copy across news, features, reviews, columns/blogs, and digital short- and long-form formats, with attention to style and professional conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce clear, engaging and illuminating copy
rubrics_metrics.description: The key issue for writers working across all forms of media: how to produce clear, engaging and illuminating copy that will keep the reader hooked from start to finish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on clarity of expression, engagement (holding reader interest), and illumination (making the subject understandable/insightful). The book frames this as the primary objective across formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep the reader hooked from start to finish
rubrics_metrics.description: Writing should 'keep the reader hooked from start to finish.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use strong openings, narrative momentum, economical paragraphing and a compelling structure to sustain attention; applicable across news, features, reviews, columns and digital formats (implicit emphasis in the book blurb).

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing news
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapters on how to write news (as one of the core genres covered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers principles and techniques specific to news writing — likely including lead construction, the pyramid structure, facts/accuracy and concise reporting — as indicated by the Table of Contents and chapter listing ('Writing news').

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing features
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapters on how to write features (as one of the core genres covered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses feature-specific requirements such as narrative development, scene-setting, quotes and depth of context; indicated by the chapter 'Writing features' in the contents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing columns and blogs
rubrics_metrics.description: Top tips and a chapter on writing columns and blogs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises developing a distinctive voice, opinion/argument clarity, reader relationship and regular-format considerations ('top tips on writing columns and blogs from leading professionals' appears in the blurb).

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: A chapter dedicated to writing reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied focus on evaluative judgment, supporting evidence/examples, balancing summary and critique, and appropriate tone for reviews (as listed in the contents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing for digital publication — shortform
rubrics_metrics.description: Expanded chapter on writing for digital publication in shortform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers digital shortform practices (e.g., concision, scannability, social-media compatibility and use of multimedia/signposting) as implied by 'writing for digital publication shortform' being an expanded chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing for digital publication — longform
rubrics_metrics.description: Expanded chapter on writing for digital publication in longform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses longform digital storytelling techniques (depth, narrative arc, multimedia integration and platform-specific formats) as indicated by the chapter listing 'writing for digital publication longform'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style and its impact on journalistic writing
rubrics_metrics.description: An exploration of the importance of style and its impact on great journalistic writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers stylistic choices (word choice, sentence rhythm, voice, grammatical conventions) and how they affect clarity, tone and reader engagement; the blurb stresses style's centrality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Familiarity with journalistic terms and further reading
rubrics_metrics.description: An extensive glossary of terms used in journalism and suggestions for further reading.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages mastery of field-specific terminology and continued learning; practical for evaluating correctness and professionalism in journalistic work.
